Our story

Where craft meets care.

Maison Élane opened on Edgewood Avenue in 2016 with one rule: no one leaves with hair they can't recreate at home. Our stylists train together every month, and every big change starts with a consultation — not a guess.

New clients welcome

A consultation may be required before certain color, extension, or major transformation services.

A deposit may be required to secure your appointment. The deposit is applied toward your service total.

Please give at least 48 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Appointments changed with less than 48 hours' notice may result in the loss of your deposit.

Arriving late may shorten your service time or require your appointment to be rescheduled.
